source.title: Recent Mathematical Results and Open Problems about Shallow Water Equations

trace.notes: Input normalized as a single zbMATH resolver URL. The zbMATH web page was Cloudflare-challenged from the CLI, so zbMATH Open API metadata was used only to identify the exact work: zbMATH document 6318154, DOI 10.1007/978-3-7643-7742-7_2, title Recent Mathematical Results and Open Problems about Shallow Water Equations.

Springer DOI and content/pdf endpoints were tried for DOI 10.1007/978-3-7643-7742-7_2. The resolved Springer page reported no access and no full HTML body; the PDF endpoint returned the paywalled HTML landing page. The only downloadable Springer artifact was a two-page preview, which is not a full technical source containing the problem statements.

HAL identifier hal-00385916 and OSKAR handles 20.500.12278/190916 and 20.500.12278/116172 confirmed the same DOI and title but exposed no readable full text. HAL API returned submitType_s=notice and openAccess_bool=false; HAL /document returned 404; OSKAR REST listed no bitstreams; the ISTEX fulltext link led to an institutional Shibboleth selection page.

OpenAlex exact DOI lookup returned open_access.is_oa=false, best_oa_location=null, and repository locations with no pdf_url. A CiteSeerX exact-title PDF candidate was inspected but its document/download endpoints returned 404. Remaining inspected candidates were metadata, abstracts, previews, paywalled pages, or not a readable exact-work full text.

No readable exact-work PDF or full HTML technical source was recovered within the bounded recovery pass. Extraction stopped under the source adequacy and no-new-facts gates rather than extracting from metadata, abstracts, search snippets, or preview text.
Saved exact JSON result to outputs/parse-paper/6318154.json and outputs/latest.json.
